title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: I SAW MY FATHER´S SOUL ON TV
original_title: EU VI PAPAI BRILHAR NA TV
overview: Clara Stuart has just turned sixteen and her classes are starting again. As the anniversary of her father’s death approaches, she decides to relive old memories and is encouraged by her grandparents to try out for a role in the school drama club’s play of Romeo and Juliet. A romantic drama about how people only truly die when they are forgotten.

title: The Final Hour
overview: A group of friends find themselves trapped in a deadly situation as a mysterious killer begins hunting them one by one during the final hour.

title: A Minecraft Movie Squared
overview: The second installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Nexus: 3001
overview: After the fall of Earth at the hands of its own creators, the remnants of humanity seek refuge on Nexus, a red planet where hope once thrived. Now, it endures under the rule of Kovino, the God whose authority is absolute and unquestioned. As quiet whispers of an old prophecy begin to resurface among the people, speaking of their savior named Wadha. As a reluctant rebel named Eli finds himself drawn toward a decision that may disturb the fragile order and set something far greater into motion for their savior to return.

title: 67 Hours
overview: From the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights, Laila sets out to cross the border into Syria to attend her father’s funeral. At one of the world’s most tightly controlled frontiers, grief collides with a system that traps her and her family in an endless state of waiting.

title: Wings
overview: A student on a field trip imagines himself as a classic pilot to work up the courage to talk to his crush.

title: Dragon's Revenge
overview: Dragon Yuen, a Hong Kong cop, comes to New Jack City to take his revenge from the powerful criminal John Rickman. With the help from his friend inspector John Campbell, he sets out to track down Rickman and put an end to his criminal activities.

title: Ghollak
overview: A man falls into begging unintentionally and enjoys it.

title: Unbearable Christmas
overview: Out-of-work weatherman Troy Tipton has one Christmas mission: retrieve the beloved teddy bear he pawned for holiday cash. With wife Becca, mother-in-law Dawn, and the kids in tow, Troy hits the road from Ohio to Florida in his old news van. But the family road trip gets even wilder when they discover the cherished bear is actually a priceless Teddy Roosevelt antique worth millions.

title: Come In From the Cold
overview: A foreign student, stranded on campus over winter break, decides to make a video diary.

title: Red Ink
overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

title: Zinnia
overview: Zinnia is a solitary woman, blind from birth, she conceals a sword inside her wlaking stick for self-defense. When she learns that Tony has been kidnapped Zinnia will have to use her skills to survive and rescue Tony from a deadly threat.

title: Complications
overview: No longer working for the CIA, Dietrich is now a ruthless mercenary on a mission to execute a high value target. But all is not what it seems, and before long the mission becomes a lot more complicated than Dietrich could have imagined.

title: Power-Man
overview: Power-Man, the masked vigilante of Vancouver, meets a new enemy when he seizes control of television and uses it to brainwash the people of the city to become his minions.

title: Sweet New Suit
overview: This film takes place within the lives of two friends that conflict with one another, as "Q" can't take responsibility for his actions and loosely getting "Jazz" involved.

title: Better Than A Shovel
overview: Carolyn and Howard are loving parents to their son Benny, but when they discover Benny may be developing unusual and dangerous behaviors, they devise a high risk mission in hopes of finding him a cure.

title: Searching 4 Saturn
overview: Set against Alabama A&M’s Homecoming Week, Searching 4 Saturn follows poet and scholar Joshua Baker as they muse on southern inheritance across time and space. The film asks what it means to be Black and Queer in a state caught between cycles of oppression and resistance.

title: The Lost Ones
overview: When a perfect family relocates to rural America, their isolated idyll quickly becomes threatened by a disturbingly volatile neighbor.

title: PR
overview: PR follows a middle-aged man in Hawaii who quietly trains for months to deadlift 300 pounds. To the gym-bros around him, his daily grind looks like vanity, ego, or some late attempt to impress women. But his real motivation remains private, as most true motivations do. Set against the ordinary rhythms of local life, PR uses time, repetition, and routine to let the everyday breathe. The film looks for a Hawaii hidden in plain sight; not the postcard fantasy, and not the weight of history, but the mundane spaces in between, where small acts of discipline and love can become their own kind of triumph.

title: Oli
overview: A Kānaka Maoli soldier returns to Hawaiʻi after losing a comrade in arms for which he blames himself. Suffering from PTSD and survivor"s guilt, Paʻakai attempts to adjust to being back on the ʻĀina. He struggles to connect with his mother, family, and friends from high school. Recognizing her son is troubled, Kaiʻs mother recommends oli (chanting) as a means to help. Can ancestral knowledge help Kai heal?

title: Massagers 4 Sale
overview: A young woman's relationship with her father reaches its crisis point when he mistakenly purchases a new line of 'massagers' and 'toys' for their Chinatown gift shop in danger of being closed down.

title: Baggage
overview: A man on the verge of leaving home finds himself unable to let go of the life he's built behind him.

title: Rent: 30th Anniversary Concert
overview: Original cast members and a bevy of special guests revive the Tony Award- and Pulitzer Prize-winning rock musical sensation Rent in a gala concert celebration for the show’s 30th anniversary. The one-night-only concert of the full show will take place on Monday, October 26, at Broadway’s Richard Rodgers Theatre as a benefit for Broadway Cares/Equity Fights AIDS.

title: The Gift (Fantaisie-Impromptu)
overview: When ten-year-old Abigail Phillips discovers a forgotten piano deep in the woods on her father's farm, she uncovers more than a passion for music - she unlocks a mystery that spans generations. In the wake of her mother's sudden passing, Abigail finds solace and purpose in music, and her natural talent quickly blossoms. Recognizing her exceptional gift, her father sends her to Paris to pursue a career as a concert pianist. Meanwhile, he begins his own investigation into the piano's mysterious origins. As he uncovers a hidden history of loss, longing, and silent lives quietly touched by the instrument, Abigail's fame begins to grow, along with the weight of the secret behind her talent.

title: $$$$$$: A STAND UP COMEDY PROGRAM by The MANDAL Man
original_title: $$$$$$: A STAND UP COMEDY PROGRAM by The MANDAL Man
overview: The MANDAL Man debut half hour stand up comedy program recorded in Brooklyn, NY.

title: A Woman Asleep
overview: Inspired by A Man Asleep by Georges Perec, A Woman Asleep explores contemporary alienation in a world of constant connection and endless information. Following a shifting group of women, the film uses synthetic imagery and the director’s own voice clone to reflect a society that keeps looking, yet no longer truly sees or feels. Based on an semi-autobiographical original script, A Woman Asleep takes an essayistic form, echoing Resnais, Marker, Antonioni, and Akerman as fiction, memory, and reflection blur.

title: Dig OR Die
overview: America’s funniest home cryptid makes his return on film! This time, he must battle with a force that threatens to doom us all…

title: Freedom Rides
overview: The 1965 Freedom Ride marked a turning point in the Australian civil rights movement when a group of 29 University of Sydney students, led by Charles Perkins, travelled through rural New South Wales to challenge racism and segregation against Aboriginal people. 7 of the Riders were Jewish, including future Chief Justice Jim Spigelman. Intimately observed by director Eliya Cohen, the film documents a commemorative journey in 2025, when Stand Up brought a new generation of Aboriginal and Jewish youth together to recreate the steps of the historic trip, building on the unique allyship between these remarkable communities.

title: Mindman
overview: An omnipotent man takes control of an unexpecting civillian.

title: The Spoon
overview: A film about a spoon.

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: ALAEA
overview: A grief-stricken son faces a series of strange events after finding blood dripping from his father’s attic.

title: Corporeal Forms: Four Stories
overview: A puppeteer's hand resurrects the missing and lost bodies of history through four stories in this lecture performance.

title: Stage Kiss
overview: When an intimacy coordinator must advise a real-life couple on a classic scene, unlikely history between both girls blurs the line between love and forbidden desire.

title: Heathens
overview: A groundbreaking 2024 University of Chicago study, presented at the Society for the Scientific Study of Religion, has uncovered something stunning: more than 50 million American Christians now conceal private doubts about their faith—a quiet crisis of doubt hidden behind Sunday smiles. This nationally representative research—the first of its kind—reveals the emotional and social toll of concealment: anxiety, shame, family rupture, and the quiet unraveling of identity in communities where belief defines belonging.

title: Holding
overview: While waiting on hold for insurance approval, a sickly man starts to hear unsettling sounds through the line that unravel a sinister secret about his claim.

title: Ho‘olono
overview: Hoʻolono, meaning “to listen deeply,” is a cinematic act of listening and an exploration of return, responsibility, and our evolving relationship to land and self. Hoʻolono is an invitation to listen deeply, to remember that the path through ecological crisis may also be a path back to ourselves.

title: Gamophobia
overview: Simon is ready to take the next step and start a relationship, but there's one problem: he can't seem to figure out how Jayden truly feels about him. Jayden is more timid when it comes to love, keeping her feelings close to her chest and leaving Simon wondering whether she feels the same way he does.

title: Tabby Daly
overview: As the potato blight tears through a rural community, a charitable woman helps young boys emigrate in search of a better life. But as quiet doubts begin to surface, questions emerge about her true intentions.

title: Satanic Panic
overview: Four RPG players in the 80s are about to get a dose of satanic panic

title: Dialing Death
overview: Three mischievous teenagers pull what they think will be a harmless prank - a late-night phone call to a random number, pretending they know dark secrets about the man on the other end. What they don't realize is that they've just called a notorious serial killer who's been lying low, and now he believes they actually know something that could expose him.

title: Nocturne
overview: Utilizing the ‘glitch’ as a portal into hidden worlds, Nocturne explores the metaphors of nothingness embedded in darkness. It suggests that the indeterminate qualities of the unknown can provide revelations of wonder rather than existential dread, and that we can move through the unknown while also carrying it with us.

title: Etude of Life
overview: In the war-torn Europe of 1944, a woman sees her life fall to pieces as she is forced to choose between her treacherous husband and an enemy officer.

title: Simon Says So
overview: An aspiring ventriloquist begins to crack under the pressure of his first performance.

title: Kavor
overview: Leon's role as Kavor (an Armenian Godfather) unravels when his cousin Vaz arrives, sparking a feud that threatens the entire wedding.

title: The Virgins
overview: Two straight-A high school girls break free for a secret weekend, unknowingly attracting the attention of two angry young men.

title: Private Restroom
overview: Under the skin of every city lies a thick layer of crime, managed globally by an unlikely front: Private Restrooms. They aren't hidden beneath the surface, but in plain sight-where you see them every day, yet never look close enough...

title: Stars on the Ceiling
overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

title: Remnant
overview: Ten years ago, Anna’s father disappeared, a fugitive wanted for mass murder. Two days ago, her estranged mother mysteriously died. But when Anna inherits her childhood home, a malicious demonic presence forces her to confront the terrifying truth of her family legacy.

title: Maleepnedos
overview: An epic journey of uncanny proportion in which two friends must adapt and survive the peculiarities of this strange new world.

title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
original_title: Can you hear me Major Tom?
overview: We’re all just floating, waiting for someone to find us.

title: Treasure Trekkers
overview: A 12-year-old monkey called Mip struggles to find his place in a world dominated by cats and rodents. A magic map sets him on a perilous quest in search of his roots in the distant land of Empathra and a journey that will teach him that kindness is a superpower.

title: Roof
overview: Trapped on the roof of a skyscraper over a holiday weekend and without communication, two co-workers attempt to escape in increasingly dangerous ways as their health deteriorates while both realize how much they have ruined their lives.

title: Hoodsteps
overview: This is the debut work of “Wosaka,” the globally popular character from the Republic of Tuktue, and the masterpiece of director Nomura Fusso, known as the ”father or mother of stop-motion animation.” The protagonist, Nomura, is an ordinary office worker at a company that manufactures adhesive bandages. One day, a face named Wosaka appears on the sole of her foot and starts moving around as it pleases. Wosaka puts on a suit, Nomura is forced to put on a shoe on her face, and they head to work upside down. As a result, the city descends into chaos! What is Wosaka’s purpose? Can Nomura return to normal?

title: Jacky
overview: Pelle is haunted by horror star Jacky as she jumps out of the TV screen. The slasher short "Jacky" is composed of recently unearthed VHS-tapes.

title: The Hatch
overview: A young couple move into their new home and when they go into the loft and bring down an old teddy bear they unwillingly invite a malevolent demon into their home.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Takkuuk
overview: Takkuuk is an Inuktitut word meaning to be attentive or to look closely. It is often used to describe the environmental and cultural changes in the Arctic. In the film of the same name, we meet musicians and researchers from the Arctic who explore life, communities, and the challenges they face.  The film is a collaboration between Belfast duo BICEP, visual artist Zak Norman, and filmmaker Charlie Miller. They weave documentary realism, music video aesthetics, and artistic abstraction together with the perspectives of indigenous peoples on the impact of colonialism and industrialization.  The narrative is punctuated by musical vignettes from Inuit and Sami artists (including Greenlandic rapper Tarrak and Sami singer Katarina Barruk), which together form the backbone of BICEP’s score. Meanwhile, specially built cameras capture the Arctic landscapes in surreal, alien colors that reflect a rapidly changing world.

title: Greeley's Creamies
overview: A mysterious snack cake brand leads its victims into a deadly parallel world if they stop consuming it.

title: Burned Edges
overview: Burned Edges is a culinary drama about ambition pushed too far.  Inside the relentless heat of a pizza kitchen, a driven chef sacrifices sleep, love, and loyalty in pursuit of greatness slowly burning the very relationships that once grounded him.  It’s a story about overwork, obsession, and the cost of chasing a dream without knowing when to stop.

title: Secrets of the Southwest
overview: Discover the hidden stories Britain's southwest has to offer. From Foxes fighting on the streets of Bristol to Puffins looking for love on Skomer Island.

title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
original_title: Secrets of the Southwest: Science Behind the Secrets
overview: Meet the inspiring individuals and communities who work to protect our most beloved UK wildlife.

title: Swimmers
overview: Marco is a timid teen who has yet to discover his own agency. Over his summer break, he signs up for a lifeguard training course, where he becomes entranced by his polar opposite, Xavier; a boy of mystery and unknown sexuality. Not wanting to risk making a fool of himself or stand out, Marco hides his feelings. When Marco is partnered up with Xavier for CPR and in-water drills, a connection begins to form. As Marco's confidence grows, so does their friendship. When it becomes clear Xavier may feel the same way, Marco must decide whether to act on his feelings or let his queer joy pass him by.

title: Half Light
overview: A man is given the opportunity for a fresh start by creating a clone of himself, but when he fails to follow the instructions properly things take a turn for the worst.

title: Multiple Choice
overview: A group of students are killed off one by one after writing a multiple choice exam. One of them is the killer...

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

title: Early Human Media
overview: At the end of their second date, Joaquin accepts Misty’s invitation up to her apartment, but the night takes a turn when her eccentric brother subjects him to a surreal trial that leaves him questioning reality and love.

title: Sugar Laced
overview: Lemonia is the owner of the most popular bakery in town, but the genius behind her most  sought-after goods is not her, but her new employee, Margarita. Margarita's repertoire  includes many types of desserts, the most renowned being her hyper realistic cakes made to  look nothing like sweets. They imitate cuts of meat, but imitation can only go so far...

title: Shadows of Beirut
overview: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: Cop This
overview: It's Grand Final Day and in a suburban police station about to be replaced by an AI 'Terminal', the two remaining cops (Nicolette Minster and Ray O'Leary) are tasked with babysitting a drug dealer for 24 hours.

title: Muurbloem
overview: Four of Madelief's best friends join her for dinner. They take a trip down memory lane, while she listens. But as the night continues, her friends push her closer to an uncomfortable reality. Whether's she's ready for it or not.

title: Duck Duck Goose
overview: While working as children’s entertainers to supplement their slow-moving acting careers, best friends Jack and Bill decide to rob a house during a 9-year-old’s birthday party. As they attempt to carry out the plan without drawing attention, tensions rise and their friendship is put under strain.

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A grieving young widower seeks healing in a spiritual mountain town but encounters a bizarre murderer and demonic forest spirits who offer him the power to cheat death at a terrifying cost.

title: Heaven in Stone and Glass
overview: On April 15, 2019, the world watched in horror as flames erupted from the rafters of Notre-Dame Cathedral – an event that captivated global audiences and ignited an overwhelming response of loss, awe, and shared cultural grief. Why did the threat to this sacred space resonate so deeply, even among those with no religious affiliation? Bishop Robert Barron returns to France to answer this question, taking the viewer on a cinematic pilgrimage.

title: By Yourself
overview: Following a breakup, Syl goes solo camping in the deep woods to unplug and connect with herself. Her solitude turns sinister when she wakes to find a neighboring tent that wasn’t there the night before.

title: AGENT: STRONG
overview: A mild-mannered family man and staunch supporter of Robert Kennedy Jr, ALEX STRONG is tasked by a mysterious agency with stopping evildoers from putting fluoride in his town's water supply; pushing him into a surreal web of conspiracies where the fate of America, and the world is at stake.

title: Jeffrey's Turn
overview: Jeffrey’s Turn based on a true life story of a young Mi’kmag man, Collin Sylliboy on the cusp of adulthood who embarks on a life changing road trip with an almost mythic figure from his past; his uncle Buck. Heeding an urgent call from his uncle, Collin has an adventure that opens his eyes to his Uncle’s tragic past of false incarceration stemming from generations of racism.  As the road unwinds, together they overcome the obstacles that are thrust in their way both externally and internally by ghosts from his uncle’s dark past. With grim determination and humor these two men bond together forever marking young Collin as he finally steps into manhood.  Jeffrey’s Turn with its universal message of coming to terms with your past while learning to live in the present is both hopeful but realistic in its portrayal of living as a Mi’kmag man in today’s society

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Lemonade
overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: The Train
overview: On the final journey of the legendary Majestic Imperator Train de Luxe, Europe’s elite boards for a farewell voyage. Owner Leo Goldberg stages a glamorous on-board show and private auction as the train travels from Vienna to Prague via Budapest, selling the Majestic to the highest bidder. But the train is more than a luxury relic: it is a controlled, mobile platform with secure compartments, limited exits, and near-total anonymity. That makes it irresistible to intelligence agencies. A Russian agent under deep cover, MI6 operatives posing as newlyweds, Chinese agents secretly wiring the train for surveillance, and a former special forces officer traveling with his daughter all converge on board. Behind champagne and polite conversation, a covert war unfolds. As the train speeds through the night, the stakes rise, trust erodes, and escape routes disappear.

title: The Cactus
overview: As Trysdale prepared for the year-end international exchange formal with Odessey and Malvous in a quiet afternoon, his thoughts drifted to an exchange student named Hecate when he once again locked eyes with the cactus she gave to him, whose fleeting connection with him had dissolved into quiet regret, or maybe there's still a glimpse of chance?

title: Katô: Dreams of Dark Earth
overview: Katô follows the Munduruku through their decades-long struggle for land and clean water, revealing a world where daily survival is an act of resistance.  Refusing to wait for government recognition, the community has taken up the mantle of self-demarcation, putting their bodies on the line to map their own return. Supporting them is a women-led video collective that transforms cameras into visual arrows, documenting the destruction while affirming a vitality that cannot be extracted. By reclaiming the Katô—the ancestral Dark Earth—the Munduruku remind us that the soil is a living witness. Their fight for the land is not merely local; it is a desperate defense of the lungs of Mother Earth, upon which all life depends.

title: The Absence of No
overview: A sexual assault allegation at a university forces those involved and the audience to confront how quickly assumptions and appearances can distort our understanding of the truth.

title: The Rattlin' Bog
overview: When three friends embark on a weekend getaway, their bond is put to the test as pride, fragile egos, and jealousy threaten to tear them apart.

title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
original_title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

title: Living Corpse
overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

title: Splash City
overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

title: Goodbye, Monster
overview: A 12-year-old boy receives one final visit from the creature under his bed, forcing him to confront fear, loss, and the emotional cost of growing up.

title: Source Connection
overview: When an investigative reporter shows up to meet her source, he proves reticent at first, but then gives the information she's looking for. Together they're working to uncover the ills of the city.

title: Raptor Attack
overview: A genetically engineered raptor escapes a secret lab and stalks a family visiting their grandmother's farmhouse, forcing them to fight for survival.

title: Cherry B
overview: It’s 1969, a housewives soiree, drinking cocktails whilst summoning up an old dead friend. When a spiritual message prompts adolescent Lilith to respond, it alerts us to the demon that lies within.

title: Return to Your Dreams
overview: Waking up from a dream he can’t seem to forget, Faizan struggles to maintain the newly structured life he’s built for himself, dazed and lost in thought. And as more memories from his past continue to resurface, he soon learns that the nightmarish ones still refuse to let him go.

title: It's Always the End of the World
original_title: It's Always the End of the World
overview: Max and Charlotte take a trip to a cabin once owned by Charlotte’s now deceased uncle. Buried in the bushes outside of the cabin, Max finds an old trunk stuffed with documents, audio cassettes and VHS tapes. The trunk’s contents point towards a half century of murder, secrets and abuse - Max slowly becomes obsessed as he grows closer and closer to learning the truth about the mystery, Britain’s past and the nature of life itself.

title: The Beach Player
overview: Former D1 volleyball star TJ O'Michael, now a washed-up beach coach, schemes to profit off a wealthy couple's collapsing marriage, with his estranged father by his side.

title: Crossroads
overview: A forensics professional returns to her childhood home for a weekend of soul-searching only to find mobsters waiting for her with a tempting offer.

title: Black Men in Uniform
original_title: Black Men in Uniform: The Untold Story
overview: Pata Seca  (1828), a man whose back bore the whip marks of his enslavers , whose eyes held the haunted memory of being forced to breed over 200 slave children in order to sustain his master’s plantation.  Men broken but unbowed, transformed from field hands into soldiers from the civil war to Vietnam.  This documentary weaves together authentic narratives from the 1800s, accompanied by original images and footage, highlighting the significant influence that Black men in uniform had in Hollywood and addressing ongoing relevant issues to date.

title: Before Me
overview: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.

title: Yu & Me
overview: When a fire destroys a beloved Chinatown bookstore, its hyper-independent owner learns that community is necessary for survival.

title: DRUID
overview: 60 AD. Romans tighten their grip on Britannia. Druidism is hunted almost to extinction. after being driven out of their commune, Rhiain- a young druid and her master Gwen are forced to flee and traverse the wilds of Britannia in order to reach the sanctuary of the Druids - Ynys Môn. On their journey they will encounter great challenges and unlikely allies on a quest that will decide not only their survival, but the future of their way of life itself.

title: Secretary
overview: When Casey, a newly hired secretary, starts getting anonymous letters from an obsessed mystery lover, she starts going down a path of terror and fear when the mystery person starts to track her down

title: Bird Flu
overview: An anxiety-ridden man’s decision to take in an injured bird leads to a deep reflection of his traumatic past and an intense physical transformation.

title: PAPERWINGS
overview: In a cramped apartment that feels like it’s collapsing in on itself, two young men try to outrun addiction and each other. Jay is fighting for sobriety. Alex is fighting not to feel. When pills resurface between them, what starts as a familiar argument spirals into a breaking point that tests the limits of love, loyalty, and survival. Paperwings is an intimate, claustrophobic portrait of codependency, recovery, and the fragile hope of choosing to live.

title: The Quiet Kind of Drowning
overview: In a town where the past never stays buried, the children of the esteemed families of Hallowridge find themselves trapped in a cycle that began long before they were born. When a new death echoes a tragedy from decades ago, old secrets rise to the surface — threatening to tear apart the people who’ve spent their lives trying to outrun them. Whispers turn to clues. Clues turn to consequences. And the truth… refuses to stay hidden.

title: The Gift
overview: After eight long years of grief, Monica - in an act of vengeance - captures the man responsible for her pain and suffering, but they both soon discover that the truth is far more complex and sickening.

title: ERASED ™
overview: Alis decides to undergo a treatment to erase a person from her traumatic past leading to one last conversation between them.

title: Spare Me!
overview: A teenage bowling prodigy enters a high-stakes tournament with one goal: win the prize money and save his struggling orphanage from closing its doors. Standing in his way is a, tatted up loud mouth desperate to claim the same prize money to pay off a dangerous mob debt. As the unlikely rivals clash, the competition spirals into a showdown filled with outrageous antics. With everything on the line, it becomes more than a battle for money— it’s a fight for survival, redemption, and the only family either of them has left.

title: I Think About Killing You
overview: Team captain Dani is plagued by invasive fantasies of killing her abusive coach. When the coach pushes the team too far, Dani must choose whether or not to act on her fantasies of violence.

title: Don't They Know It's the End of the World?
original_title: Don't They Know It's the End of the World?
overview: Two people on a date realize their circumstances prevent them from ever having a serious relationship. They create a fantasy that they're married, leading to existential consequences.

title: World Beyond: Ground Zero
overview: In a harsh, lawless world where trust is rare and survival comes at a cost.

title: Tiger's Rampage

title: Stories About My Body
overview: In a tiny theatre in Aotearoa, New Zealand, four teenage stagehands work tirelessly to help Morgana tell the stories that shaped her - from her own teenagehood in 1998, to working foot-fetish parties in New York City, to falling in love and later birthing her babies in a Melbourne living room.  By turns vulnerable and riotously funny, she moves from lamenting her chins to marvelling at her cellular functions, using her body as the living template for every tale she tells.  Created and performed by Morgana O'Reilly (The White Lotus) and co-directed with her husband and real-life birth partner, 2025 BAFTA nominee Peter Salmon (After The Party), Stories About My Body blends nudity, heart-swelling honesty and real birth footage into a stand-up comedy special like no other - intimate, fearless and unexpectedly profound.

title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
overview: With unprecedented access to the official archives and intimate recollections from the band, both current and past,  Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition invites fans to experience one of the most iconic journeys in music history.  Spanning five decades, this electrifying documentary charts the band’s rise from the pubs of East London to the world’s biggest stadiums. Featuring exclusive interviews with band members and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich and Chuck D, as well as all-new animated sequences of the band's legendary mascot, Eddie, the film offers a rare and intimate look at Iron Maiden’s uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their truly global army of fans.

title: White Nine
overview: White Nine is both a historical account of the independent living movement in Massachusetts and a compelling story of resilience, the power of collective action, and the enduring quest for equality, independence, and freedom for all. Fifty years ago, Joe, Christos, and Charlie, formed a profound bond as teens when their lives were forever changed by paralyzing spinal cord injuries-essentially a death sentence at that time. Their intertwined stories form the backbone of a larger narrative: the arduous fight for independence and civil rights for people with disabilities. Today, with enforcement weakening and legal challenges mounting, the ADA's promise of equality faces serious threats. As a country, we must actively defend these vital civil rights now to ensure people with disabilities are not pushed back into the margins. White Nine serves as a reminder of the battles fought, the progress achieved, and the critical work that still lies ahead.

title: Kintsugi
overview: Kintsugi (金継) is a Japanese practice of repairing broken pottery with gold. The breaks and repairs are thus made visible, displayed rather than hidden. Human relationships aren't like pottery; perhaps they're more complex than simply repairing a plate. However, there's a certain parallel between our reunion and this ancient technique. Undoubtedly, there are wounds that were exposed by the distance that separated us for over a month. This isn't something to be ignored or hidden. However, that doesn't mean these emotional wounds can't be repaired. On the contrary, they become the foundation upon which we can build a strong bond. And that's what I want; I want to reclaim what was taken from us, our relationship. Ana Martes, I love you like I've never loved anyone before.
